Robotics Software Engineer Co-op

Boston, MA (Hybrid)

About Northwind Robotics

Northwind Robotics builds warehouse robots that work safely alongside people.

What you'll do

  • Implement motion-planning features in C++ and Python.
  • Write quaternion calibration tooling for our arm fleet.
  • Partner with hardware engineers to debug sensor pipelines.

Qualifications

  • Pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field.
  • Experience with Linux and Git.
  • Nice to have: ROS 2 experience.

Compensation

The hourly pay range for this co-op is $32–$40 per hour.

How to apply

Submit your resume and an unofficial transcript through this page by the posted date.
